content: Svapna nidra jnanalambanam va. (Or contemplation on the wisdom gained from dreams and deep sleep stabilizes the mind).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Svapna nidra jnanalambanam va. (Or contemplation on the wisd...) focuses directly on svapna and nidra. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on svapna today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper svapna and nidra in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
